CIRCUIT: five op-amp stages. A 5V source and a 10A source each drive an inverting-style pair of op-amps (feedback element across each amp: C0 1uF, L1 1uH, L13 1uH, C9 1uF, L17 1uH), and the three output stages each end in a 1k resistor onto a common right-hand rail at x~917. All op-amp + inputs except U3's are tied to their own GND symbol.

JUDGEMENT CALLS:
  S30 (417,555) = JUNCTION - this is the one real decision on the sheet and it OVERRIDES the tracer's default of 'crossing'. The long x~437 column from U3's + input crosses the middle rail here. Evidence: (a) there is no hop and no jog - the pixel dump over x[394,447) y[530,582) shows the column running straight through at x=415..419 and the rail running straight through at y=551..558; the tracer's hop score of 7.7 comes only from the rail sloping up ~5 px to the right across the intersection, i.e. a 7.7 degree bend, whereas a drawn hop swings ~90 degrees (compare S6 of circuit_847). (b) the ink at the intersection thickens from 3 px to 5-6 px over ~12 rows, consistent with a deliberate junction blob rather than a clean pass-over. (c) Electrically, the crossing reading leaves U3's + input DC-floating (its only companion would be one plate of C21) and leaves C21 coupling two high-impedance nodes with no source; the junction reading gives U3's + input a DC path to U15's low-impedance output and gives the U20 stage a real input (AC-coupled from U15's output through C21). Consequence of the other reading: n5 would split into {U3.in+, C21 left} and {U15.out, L13 right, R12 left}.
  S13 (503,197), S27 (634,548), S29 (394,555), S32 (917,558), S37 (215,626), S41 (598,879) = JUNCTION. Every one is a plain T: a riser or a component lead ending on a through wire, with nothing passing over. Verified in the site crops - at S29 the U15 output riser has only a 3 px overshoot above the rail and no ink below-left of it, at S32 the R10 lead ends on the right-hand rail, and so on. Reading any of them as a crossing would strand an op-amp input or a resistor end on a 1-terminal net.
  S6 (197,141), S11 (374,184), S14 (218,212), S18 (650,225), S20 (733,483), S31 (800,558), S38 (393,666), S42 (747,885) = JUNCTION. Also plain T's / apex meets (op-amp output apex plus its feedback riser).
